problem.title: Minimum Cost to Connect All Cities
problem.problemStatement: There are N cities and a list of possible roads connecting pairs of cities with associated construction costs. Determine the minimum total cost required to connect all cities. If it is impossible, print -1.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and M. • Next M lines contain integers u, v, and cost.
problem.output: Print the minimum total construction cost.
